source_refs.note: Exercise 6.2, Question 2: show 4x + 3y - 25 = 0 is tangent to x^2 + y^2 = 25 and find the point of contact; book p. 182, answers p. 305 (PDF 307)

blocks.prompt: 2. Show that the line \(4x + 3y - 25 = 0\) is tangent to the circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 25\) and find the point of contact.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do kaam hain: saabit karna ke line tangent hai, aur woh point nikalna jahan woh circle ko chhooti hai.
Diya kya hai? Line \(4x + 3y - 25 = 0\) aur circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 25\).
Find kya karna hai? Tangency ka saboot aur point of contact.
Rule kaunsa? Corollary 1: \(y = mx + c\) tangent hai agar \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2)\). Corollary 2: point of contact ka formula.
Plan: line ko \(y = mx + c\) mein likho, condition check karo, phir formula se point. Aakhir mein point ko line aur circle dono mein rakh kar tasdeeq bhi karenge, taake koi shak na rahe.
steps:
Diya gaya: line \(4x + 3y - 25 = 0\); circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 25\), yani \(a = 5\).
Saabit karna: line tangent hai. Maloom karna: point of contact.
Tareeqa: \(y = mx + c\) circle \(x^2 + y^2 = a^2\) ko touch karti hai agar \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2)\). Phir \(c > 0\) ho to point of contact \(\left(\frac{-am}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}}, \frac{a}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}}\right)\).

Slope-intercept form
\[3y = -4x + 25\]
\[y = -\tfrac{4}{3}x + \tfrac{25}{3}\]
\[m = -\tfrac{4}{3},\quad c = \tfrac{25}{3}\]
Kyun: Condition \(y = mx + c\) shakal ke liye bani hai, is liye pehle line ko isi shakal mein laya. \(4x\) ko right par le gaye, phir poori equation ko 3 se divide kiya. Yahan \(c\) line ka \(y\)-intercept hai (jahan line \(y\)-axis ko kaat-ti hai), circle ki general equation wala \(c\) nahi; dono ka naam ek jaisa hai is liye ulajhna nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(m\) nikalte waqt sign ka khayal rakhein: \(4x\) right par ja kar \(-4x\) banta hai, is liye slope negative hai.

Condition check karein
\[c^2 = \tfrac{625}{9}\]
\[a^2(1 + m^2) = 25\left(1 + \tfrac{16}{9}\right) = \tfrac{625}{9}\]
Kyun: Dono barabar aaye, matlab line aur circle ko mila kar banne wali quadratic ka discriminant zero hai: sirf ek common point. Yahi tangent hone ki pehchan hai. Yaad kijiye 6.2.5 ke teen cases: \(a^2(1 + m^2) > c^2\) ho to line circle ko do points par kaat-ti hai, barabar ho to sirf chhooti hai, aur kam ho to milti hi nahi. Humare paas barabar wala case hai.
Yeh condition aati kahan se hai? Line \(mx - y + c = 0\) ka origin se faasla \(\frac{|c|}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}}\) hai. Tangent ke liye yeh radius \(a\) ke barabar hona chahiye; dono taraf square karein to \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2)\) ban jata hai. Yani yeh formula "faasla = radius" hi ki doosri shakal hai.
Khud sochiye: agar line \(4x + 3y - 20 = 0\) hoti to kya hota? (Jawab: \(c^2 = \frac{400}{9} < \frac{625}{9}\), faasla 4 radius 5 se kam, to line circle ko do points par kaat-ti, tangent na hoti.)
Dhyan dein: \(25\left(1 + \frac{16}{9}\right)\) mein pehle bracket ko \(\frac{25}{9}\) banayein, phir 25 se multiply karein; \(25 + \frac{16}{9}\) likhna ghalat hoga.

Point of contact
\[\sqrt{1 + m^2} = \tfrac{5}{3}\]
\[x = \dfrac{-am}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}} = \dfrac{-5(-\frac{4}{3})}{\frac{5}{3}} = 4\]
\[y = \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}} = \dfrac{5}{\frac{5}{3}} = 3\]
Kyun: \(c = +a\sqrt{1 + m^2}\) positive hai, is liye Corollary 2 ka pehla point. \(\sqrt{1 + \frac{16}{9}} = \sqrt{\frac{25}{9}} = \frac{5}{3}\). \(x\) mein: \(-5 \times \left(-\frac{4}{3}\right) = \frac{20}{3}\), aur \(\frac{20}{3} \div \frac{5}{3} = 4\). \(y\) mein: \(5 \div \frac{5}{3} = 3\). Fraction ko fraction se divide karte waqt doosre fraction ko ulta kar ke multiply karte hain. Geometry se bhi samjhein: point of contact origin se line par giraye gaye perpendicular ka qadam (foot) hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(c\) negative hota to doosra point \(\left(\frac{am}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}}, \frac{-a}{\sqrt{1 + m^2}}\right)\) lena parta; sign zaroor dekhein.

Tasdeeq
\[4(4) + 3(3) - 25 = 0,\quad 16 + 9 = 25 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((4, 3)\) line par bhi hai aur circle par bhi. Ek aur tareeqa: origin se line ka faasla \(\frac{|-25|}{\sqrt{16 + 9}} = 5\), jo radius ke barabar hai. Exam mein tangency saabit karne ka yeh faasle wala tareeqa sab se chhota hai, lekin kitab ne Corollary 1 sikhaya hai, is liye pehle wahi likha. Point of contact ko seedha bhi nikal sakte the: \(y = \frac{25 - 4x}{3}\) circle mein rakhein to \((x - 4)^2 = 0\) aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2) = \frac{625}{9}\), is liye line tangent hai; point of contact \((4, 3)\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Exercise 6.2 ki answer key ki numbering ek qadam aage khisak gayi hai. Key 2 mein sirf general condition \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2)\) aur general points of contact likhe hain, aur key 3 wala \((4, 3)\) asal mein isi sawal ka point of contact hai. Key 2 aur 3 ko mila kar Question 2 ka jawab samjhein; is ke baad key 4 = Question 3, key 5 = Question 4, key 6 = Question 5 aur key 7 = Question 6.
